rules: offer: "salarium-connect:1:" then six values joined by ":": relay node key, sid, Q (X25519), P (Ed25519), origin, name; base64url without padding; keys 32 bytes; origin and name UTF-8
link: "https://salarium.io/connect#" followed by the offer's text

origin: "https://" or "http://", a host of lowercase ASCII DNS labels (letters, digits, '-', none at a label's ends, no trailing dot) or an IPv6 address in brackets, and ":port" (no leading zero, not the scheme's default) when the page has one; 1 to 128 bytes
a wallet connects to https:// origins; a debug build also to http://localhost, http://127.0.0.1 and http://[::1] with any port
ConnectLogin: Borsh {network [32] (genesis hash), account [20], origin String (u32 length + UTF-8), sid [32], page [32] (P), at u64 (Unix ms)}
message = BLAKE3 derive_key("Salarium connect login v1", Borsh(ConnectLogin)); an Ed25519 signer signs the 32 bytes (strict verification), a P-256 signer signs SHA-256 of them as r ‖ s with s ≤ n/2
ConnectGrant: Borsh {version u8 = 1, login, signer DeviceKey (tag 0 Ed25519 [32], tag 1 P256 [33] compressed), signature [64]}

ConnectSeen: Borsh {tag u8 = 0, at u64}; ConnectReply: Borsh {tag u8 = 2, relay [32] (the node key of the wallet's relay), sid [32] (its reply slot), key [32] (K, X25519), login [32] (the message of the login that follows)}; a payload's first byte tells them apart: 0 seen, 1 grant, 2 reply, 3 companion (46-connect-lock §3.2, vectors/connect-verify-v1.json), anything else refused; one value, nothing after it

ConnectConfirm: Borsh {version u8 = 1, login [32] (the message of the login the page took), at u64}; sealed to the reply's key K as a link payload with aad = reply sid ‖ P and delivered to the reply slot (link_deliver from the page's slot connection); the wallet takes it when: version 1; login is the message of the login it sent; |at − now| ≤ 600000 ms; it shows connected on the page's confirmation, or says the login was sent and not confirmed after 10 s (19-connect §14)

ConnectRefusal: Borsh {version u8 = 2, login [32] (the message of the login the page refused), at u64, reason u8, when u64}; sealed and delivered as a confirmation, which the wallet tells apart by the first byte (1 confirm, 2 refusal, anything else refused); taken by the same rules (login, |at − now| ≤ 600000 ms); reason 0 other, 1 not on the site's list, 2 its time ended at when, 3 its time begins at when, 4 no files, 5 try again in a minute; a byte above 5 reads as 0; when is read beside 2 and 3 only, and a when of 0 is no moment (19-connect §14.2)

payload: base64url of E ‖ XChaCha20-Poly1305(key, nonce = 24 zero bytes, aad = sid ‖ P), E = X25519(e, 9), S = X25519(e, Q), key = BLAKE3 derive_key("Salarium link payload v1", S ‖ E ‖ Q); e = one_time_secret

the page takes a grant when: version 1; network, origin, sid and page are its session's; |at − now| ≤ 600000 ms; the signature verifies under signer; and by the account's key event log (account_log): an empty log and an Ed25519 signer whose personal id (BLAKE3 derive_key("Salarium address v1", [0] ‖ key)) is the account, or a log that checks offline from its origin (13-accounts §7) whose controller lists the signer as a device that is not a guardian

the address shown: the account's 20 bytes in their one Bech32m form (q), whatever its kind; the kind shown beside it: personal (0) for an empty log or a log whose origin is a key (an upgraded account), managed (5) for a log whose origin is a root

logs: "none" (empty), "managed" and "managed-without-phone" (accounts-v1.json's managed account), "managed-payments" (the same account's phone added by the root, then a BuyWork registry call signed by the root and the phone and a transfer signed by the root alone: events because the root signed, whose actions a page may pass over), "upgraded" (accounts-v1.json's upgrade as its account's first event, slot 50)
